backtest._note: dk_user: the DraftKings user whose entries are ours in a standings export ('SamBamCH (3/10)'); the results ledger and the backtest view count them (ivan.sports.nba.backtest.results)

field._note: the field is its own lineups from the fitted two-group model (data/nba/models/field_two_group.json) on the public projection; every candidate is scored against it (field.public_field, contest.simulate.simulate_vs_field)

projection._n_worlds_note: n_worlds (2026-11-09): worlds the game simulation draws per game when a team is projected (the desk's Refigure, a publish, project.py): every player's fantasy points, minutes and stats on the pool are the means over them, the sd and the 101 quantiles their spread. About 0.7 s a game at 1000. Replaced n_sims (the old minutes x rates Monte Carlo).
projection._alloc_note: solve (2026-10-24): per-team quadratic solve on anchors (books' implied minutes for priced players, history for the rest, desk edits held) within position-group budgets; headroom = the old allocator
projection._depth_note: depth_cut (2026-10-24): the grid plays the team's measured rotation depth (players with 5+ min over the last 10 games, 8..12) plus depth_extra; the rest get no minutes and leave the pool. Backtest under live-like availability: rotation players' error falls (28+ min MAE 3.98 vs 4.53), the cut fringe is over-penalised (fpts MAE overall 8.34 vs 7.55, bias +1.1). false = every available player keeps his expected minutes.
projection._pool_note: pool (2026-10-25): which players are tonight's rotation. depth_cut = the measured depth above. last_game = the rotation of the last ordinary game this group played together (5+ min that night), minus tonight's outs, plus the returners (available, usual 15+ min); the depth cut stands when the team has no such game.
projection._team_profile_note: team_profile (2026-10-26): the coach's pattern per team from its ordinary games this season, shrunk toward the league (projection/team_profile.py): how long the starters hold the tip and the Q3 tip, the lean to close the half with starters, and the starter / bench minutes the role prior pulls a named starter (or a benched regular) toward (minutes.STARTER_PRIOR_W = 0.6 of the way, scaled by how rarely he started). false = the fixed 3-minute spans and the old +6 start shift.

gamesim._garbage_note: garbage (2026-11-09): whether the World pulls the closers once the lead beats the threshold for the time left. Off: the grid's minutes are the books' implied minutes, which already carry the blowout discount, so a pull on top double counts it (57% of worlds on 2026-11-09's 156338, every star 4 minutes short, the end of every bench 5 long). docs/nba/notes/garbage_time_2026-11-09.md.
gamesim._cuts_note: cuts (2026-11-10): the soft pool (projection/cuts.py, data/nba/models/cuts.json). all = every row but a named starter carries his own chance of being cut tonight (under 8 minutes: his recent cut rate by role); a typed minutes pin or a locked row says how long he plays when he plays, not whether the coach uses him. Every available player the plan left at zero or you dropped carries his chance of playing a few minutes. unpinned = a typed minutes pin is certain too. off = the pool is hard, as before. docs/nba/notes/minutes_distribution_2026-11-10.md.
